tagline: A browser for agents, and a new look for the office.
subtitle: The Preview becomes a shared browser, replies read like paper, and a courier rides the office.

cards.title: A browser agents can drive
cards.text: Agent-browser or Playwright on one shared session that keeps its logins: cookies held 30 days, stored encrypted.

cards.title: Replies on the office's paper
cards.text: Commands come as terminal slips you can run, tables and code are framed, and MCP calls show their result.

cards.title: A git courier, and a carrom can
cards.text: A commit, push or pull request leaves through a hatch in the wall on a green scooter; the lounge cabinets count commands.

cards.title: Storage as a treemap
cards.text: The Storage tab sizes each workspace as a tile, and the Share tab no longer counts a lump in an allowance as others' use.
